selection_rule.reason_not_result_selected: CN:600887 is selected to add a branded dairy producer whose raw-milk procurement, cold-chain distribution, product mix, channel economics and working-capital conversion present a different operating mechanism from the prior industrial, service and premium-spirits Blind cases. preoutcome_research_problem.materiality_statement: The forecaster must decide from the frozen issuer packet whether the company can translate branded product and channel scale into durable customer absorption, responsibility-matched economics and owner-cash conversion. This registration makes no factual or directional company judgment.
preoutcome_research_problem.state_and_constraint: Separate a scaled branded dairy platform's procurement and cold-chain commitments from demonstrated product demand, price-volume resilience, channel economics and cash conversion.
preoutcome_research_problem.management_choice_or_no_action: Assess product-mix, channel, supply-chain, capacity and capital-allocation choices or no-action without presuming their outcome.
preoutcome_research_problem.customer_or_operating_link: Trace any claimed operating strength through product sales, volume and pricing where disclosed, channel/customer adoption, gross-profit or unit-economics carrier and execution before giving enterprise credit.
preoutcome_research_problem.cash_or_capital_link: Separate revenue and accounting profit from collection, inventory, receivables, procurement commitments, operating cash flow and capital spending before treating a result as owner cash or capital return.

selection_agent_read_boundary: date-bounded metadata for the three named original annual reports
no annual-report body, outcome source, price, return, analyst material or derived company report
role_and_source_firewall.preoutcome_source_allowed_for_next_forec: Only the three documents named in 96_CN600887_CUTOFF_BEFORE_SOURCE_PACKET_RECEIPT.json and the worktree AGENTS.md instructions required for the isolated role.
role_and_source_firewall.outcome_source_sealed: No FY2024-or-later issuer source, result metadata or outcome body may be accessed until a fresh forecaster freezes a judgment contract and a result-free independent preoutcome reviewer accepts it.

activation_prerequisites: fresh forecaster preoutcome judgment is frozen
independent result-free preoutcome review accepts the judgment contract

may_read: the accepted preoutcome judgment contract solely to identify frozen settlement cells
the one authorized issuer official FY2024 annual report solely to settle matching operating or cash/capital cells

custodian_authority_frozen.mismatch_treatment: A non-matching, non-disclosed or perimeter-incompatible measure receives LOCAL_UNKNOWN or MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH for that cell only. It does not invalidate remaining contracted cells or create a new global gate.
